question: Create a horizontal lollipop chart showing the log2 fold change of the top 20 differentially expressed genes (by adjusted p-value). Order genes by log2 fold change (ascending) along the y-axis. Use red for upregulated and blue for downregulated genes. Add a vertical reference line at zero.

expected_output.description: log2 fold change as x-axis, genes as y-axis, red for upregulated, blue for downregulated
